name: Katherine Gibson
original_name: カトリーヌ・ギブスン
source:
Age: 14 (18 in the English version)

Katherine is Jean-Jacque's only daughter, who is a model. Most of her modeling work is for advertisements on Hologram Signs.

Katherine is also a very clever young woman who is continuing to study hard for her future after modeling. She is a very strong willed young lady who can be surprisingly vulnerable at times.

[From [url=http://www.justinaaron.com/thekremlin/katrina.html]The Kremlin[/url]]
